detailed_descriptions.en: Dino Running from a FURRY: GAMESFORFARM Dangerous Mr. Furry is already on your trail — and it is better not to find out what happens if he catches you… Dino Running from a FURRY: GAMESFORFARM is a bright 2.5D runner where you must escape from a huge and dangerous pursuer, collect coins, overcome unexpected obstacles, and set new records. Every attempt is a chance to last longer, collect more coins, and prove that your Dino is the fastest! Game features: Dynamic runner gameplay Pleasant and colorful graphics 2.5D format with an engaging presentation Various and unpredictable obstacles Coins, records, and the desire to try again Dino customization More than 10 clothing options for your character Collect coins, unlock new looks, and try to set the highest record. Most importantly — do not stop. Mr. Furry is already close!
